scope.execution: exact production bytes copied into a disposable isolated repository root

cases.proof: Making the current installed capability available leaves both exact Markdown byte streams authoritative and creates no HTML files.
Preview is non-mutating; explicit apply creates a same-slug HTML pair in DRAFT, transfers no approvals, and removes Markdown only after the pair transaction commits.

A prepared cutover is fault-injected after the spec switch but before the plan switch. Discovery rejects the mixed pair, engine reads return RECOVERY_REQUIRED, explicit complete recovery restores the HTML pair, and identical operation replay returns the durable result.
A client without the installed payload fails CAPABILITY_MISSING while routing remains HTML; it neither recreates nor reinterprets Markdown.
Journal-bound rollback removes both HTML authorities, restores both recorded SHA-256 byte streams exactly, and retains the cutover and rollback transaction journals.
During the fault-injected prepared cutover, exact-format discovery and the engine recovery guard both stop before the dispatch boundary is reached.

limitations: The mapping is a safety-only fixture disposition over every source line; semantic_mapping_verified remains false and this is not adoption of the selected pair.
No historic approval or task status is transferred, and no production authority capture is manufactured.
The drill uses exact production bytes in a disposable isolated repository root rather than mutating the authoritative codeArbiter pair.
The local candidate observation is not hosted exact-head evidence; the status must not be promoted until the committed revision passes required CI.
Physical power loss and remote or network filesystems remain unqualified.
The HTML farm is outside this pilot and remains disabled.
